title: Member Equities & Patronage Disclosure to Borrowers — The Borrower Stock Requirement at Each Loan Closing
content:
Every borrower must own Member Equities & Patronage borrower equity of the class matching their segment before any loan closes.

## The requirement

1. **Required holding.** The required holding is the lesser of the class's requirement cap and the class's requirement percentage of the combined original principal (or commitment, for operating lines) of all the member's open loans including the one closing, rounded up to a whole purchase increment of the class.
2. **Purchase at closing.** At each closing the member buys the difference between the required holding and the borrower equity already held, if positive, paid in cash at closing or deducted from the loan proceeds; nothing is bought when the existing holding already meets the requirement, and the holding never exceeds the requirement cap.
3. **First loan.** A member applying for a first loan subscribes with the application; the equity is issued on the closing date, and if the loan is declined or withdrawn the subscription is cancelled and anything paid is refunded within the class's subscription refund period in calendar days, recorded with the reason subscription cancelled.
4. **At risk.** Borrower equity is at risk and is retired only under the rules on retirement after loan payoff, estate retirement and offset against a defaulted loan.

## Quantities the requirement reads

- **Combined loan amount**: the commitment of each operating line plus the original principal of every other loan of the member in an open status, at the date considered, including the loan being closed.
- **Borrower equity already held**: the balance of the member's Class C Participation Certificate, Class A Nonvoting Common Stock or Class B Voting Stock holding in subscribed or active status (0.00 when there is none).
- **Open status**, by product line:
- Operating Lines of Credit: applied, active, suspended or matured;
- Equipment & Vehicle Loans: applied, active, deferred or nonaccrual;
- Farm Real Estate Loans: applied, active or nonaccrual;
- Rural Home Loans (the Country Home loans): applied, active, forbearance or nonaccrual;
- Construction Loans: applied, active, extended or converting.

The requirement percentage, requirement cap, purchase increment, payment methods and subscription refund period of each class are those in the class schedule of stock requirement and purchase terms.

## Worked closings (hypothetical members; class figures from the class schedule: 2 percent, cap USD 1000, increment USD 5)

| Member's open loans including the one closing | Combined loan amount | 2 percent | Required holding | Already held | Bought at closing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A first Country Home loan of USD 21,660 | USD 21,660 | USD 433.20 | USD 435.00 (rounded up to a whole USD 5) | USD 0.00 | USD 435.00 |
| An operating line committed at USD 150,000 and a farm real estate loan of USD 400,000 now closing | USD 550,000 | USD 11,000.00 | USD 1,000.00 (the cap) | USD 600.00 | USD 400.00 |
| An equipment loan of USD 40,000 now closing and an operating line committed at USD 50,000 | USD 90,000 | USD 1,800.00 | USD 1,000.00 (the cap) | USD 1,000.00 | Nothing |

A loan that is closing counts in the combined amount even though it is not yet booked; a loan that has been paid off and closed is not in an open status and does not count.
